PLAN_GENERATE:
Output: plan_action, type, steps, execution_mode, reasoning, adaptive_granularity, next_action.
Assess already ran: ``Status: …, Progress: …`` is authoritative. Goal is in ````.
**Language lock**: - Use the same natural language as the current goal statement in ````. - Apply this consistently to ``steps[].description``, ``steps[].expected_output``, ``reasoning``, and ``next_action``. - Do not switch output language unless the user explicitly requests another language. - Keep code, file paths, identifiers, and quoted literals unchanged.
**Step count**: Follow EXECUTION_POLICIES (first wave: 1–2 only; later: 1–3).
**plan_action**: ``keep`` (reuse plan) or ``new`` (fresh decision per rules above).
**type**: - ``execute_steps``: Required at iteration 0 or when step_results empty. - ``final``: ONLY after execute_steps produced sufficient evidence. NEVER at iteration 0.
**steps** fields: - ``id``: Short token (``01``, ``02``) or per ````. - ``description``: Milestone line (<20 words). Executor handles fine-grained work. - ``expected_output``: Checkable completion signal. - ``dependencies``: Optional; step ids this depends on. - ``kind``: ``action`` (default) or ``ask_user``. See . - ``questions``: REQUIRED when ``kind=ask_user``; list of plain-text questions the user must answer before the goal can continue. Forbidden otherwise.
Emit ``kind="ask_user"`` ONLY when continuing requires information that is not present in the goal, context, or recent step outputs and cannot be inferred — e.g. an unstated preference, an unknown constraint, an ambiguous reference that meaningfully changes the plan. The runtime answers the question through the configured clarification relay and resumes planning automatically; do NOT also produce prose like "Please tell me…" in ``description``.
Rules: - Emit AT MOST ONE ``ask_user`` step per wave; pair it with no other steps so later actions can use the answer. - Populate ``questions`` with one or more concrete questions. Each question must end in ``?`` and be self-contained. - Set ``description`` to a short third-person summary (e.g. ``Ask which target format the user wants``); the question text itself belongs in ``questions``. - Do NOT use ``ask_user`` to confirm a step you could just do, to surface a status update, or when context already supplies the answer.
**execution_mode** (required when ``type=execute_steps``): only ``parallel`` or ``dependency``. - ``parallel`` (default): independent steps; executor may run them concurrently (bounded by config). - ``dependency``: only when one or more steps set ``dependencies``; executor respects the DAG. - Never output ``sequential`` (removed); invalid values fail validation.
**reasoning**: Brief third-person justification. **next_action**: First person, one sentence, max ~300 chars.
**On failure**: If prior steps failed, propose a different approach—do not repeat same step text.
